not_proved: (a) The new tests were never seen red on the base product in the real runner on GitHub. Is that proof required for a PASS under Q6? My answer: no. Q6 forbids cheating (skip, weakened tests, removed steps) and I found none; Q5 asks for a test per criterion, which the CI record and the criterion-to-test mapping give. In its place stand: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's mirrored drivers on the base files (all 7 sections red, 34 of 35 designer mutants red, 1 equivalent), my own base-versus-work key comparison (13 keys absent on base, the 2 values differ) and my 8 of 8 mutants against my own driver. What it does not prove: that the real LD-3, LD-6, LD-9, TX-4, TX-9 and TX-10 fail with their intended messages on the base (a mirror copies the test text and can drift). I recommend the second snapshot (be3c52f) as cheap insurance and reading the messages of the red tests, but it is not a condition of my verdict.

(b) Headless Chrome only, one engine (Chrome 157 on Windows); no Firefox, Safari or real phone; no Vercel production check (the post-deploy record stays for after the release); no touch-device behaviour.
(c) kk is unread by a native speaker (ISS-0127); kk is hidden on production (G9); the kk values pass my lint script, which proves only the word lists and the text rule.

The repo's own tests were not run by me (owner's rule); my evidence for them is the GitHub record of b22f71e, whose app/ equals HEAD's app/, but whose tools/ and records are main's e0a425b, not HEAD's.
Criterion 11, the owner's 'похоже' at G21, is not given: PENDING THE OWNER.
